run_scenario: run a Gaia2 scenario inside a container end-to-end and return the graded result dict
build_container_env: build the effective environment dict for the container including judge model provider and API key
poll_for_response: poll the adapter status endpoint until the daemon reports scenario completion or timeout expires
extract_user_task: extract the initial user task message from the scenario JSON events list
save_artifacts: save run artifacts including events JSONL agent response result JSON and openclaw log to disk
